params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Every few seconds, {{ci|Gragas}} will {{tip|heal}} a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}} upon casting an {{tip|ability}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, after casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Gragas''' {{tip|heals}} himself for {{as|{{sti|health|{{fd|5.5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gragas}} rolls a cask to the target location that lingers for a short time before exploding. ''Barrel Roll'' can be recast within the duration once it fully travels.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gragas''' detonates the cast, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies. The effects are increased based on how long the cask lingered.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' rolls a cask to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. Upon arrival, the cask starts to ferment over the first 2 seconds of its duration to increase its {{ccs|damage|magic}} and the effectiveness of its {{tip|slow}}, up to a maximum of 150% of their initial values. ''Barrel Roll'' can be recast at any time within its duration after the cask has fully travelled, and does so automatically after its duration ends.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gragas''' detonates the cask, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, reduced by 30% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds.
params.outofrange: Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
params.notes:
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Deactivating the ability manually does not.
* The cask ignores unit and terrain collision therefore it will only stop once it reaches the target location.
** On arrival the cask will begin to glow ever brighter as it ferments until it turns bright red.
* ''Barrel Roll'' has an internal cooldown while traveling so that '''Gragas''' may only make it explode on arrival.
* The charge-up countdown will only start once the cask stops rolling.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The ability will not preserve the caster's facing direction when using {{si|Flash}} and similar effects.

params.blurb2: His next {{tip|basic attack}} will deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the target and nearby enemies based on each {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, drinking out of his brew, and gains damage reduction for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.description2: Upon completing the channel, '''Gragas''' empowers his next [[basic attack]] within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the target and nearby enemies, reduced to 50% against [[structures]]. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 140}} {{as|(+ 7% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* The enhanced attack will apply other [[on-hit effect]]s and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.
* The empowered attack will trigger against [[structures]].
* The empowered attack will trigger against [[ward]]s but not be consumed nor apply its effects against [[ward]]s.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Gragas''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Gragas}} {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction, stopping upon the first enemy hit, which deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}}, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them.
params.blurb2: If ''Body Slam'' hits an enemy, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction and stops upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, though not through terrain, and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
params.description2: ''Body Slam's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 40% if '''Gragas''' hits an enemy.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Barrel Roll|Gragas}} and {{ai|Explosive Cask|Gragas}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|180|Center-to-center collision radius}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|180|Center-to-edge collision lollipop. This lollipop it located 30 units in front of his dash end location.}}}}
params.notes:
* {{si|Flash}} can be casted during ''Body Slam'', instantly ending it and affecting enemies at the flash location.
* Units hit by ''Body Slam'' turn away from '''Gragas'''.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gragas}} hurls a cask to the target location that explodes upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' hurls a cask that travels to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, exploding on impact to deal {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within the area and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 900 units, though not through terrain, from the epicenter of the explosion, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
